title: agrostis alba subvar. coarctata
intro: Agrostis alba subvar. coarctata, commonly known as Alpine Hair Grass, is a subspecies of plant native to high-altitude regions. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis alba subvar. coarctata may include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and effects.
